title: ADR tooling config
description: Configuration consumed by @kompiro/adr-tools. Required at the directory where adr commands are invoked (typically the repo root).

idFormat.description: ADR id / filename convention. `date-sequence` expects `YYYYMMDD-NN-<slug>.md` (id `ADR-YYYYMMDD-NN`); `issue-number` expects `<n>-<slug>.md` (id `ADR-<n>`, no zero padding).

topics.description: Controlled vocabulary for ADR `topic` field. Empty array disables vocabulary checks.

concerns.description: Controlled vocabulary for `scope.concerns`. Empty array disables vocabulary checks.

adrDir.description: Directory containing ADR markdown files (relative to CWD).

permalink.description: Opt-in support for `permalink:` frontmatter linking an ADR to a rendered structure. Enables `adr check-permalinks`.

kind.description: Resolver for a deep `#fragment` anchor a `source` may carry. `krs` resolves karasu `#krs-<view>-<id>` anchors via the optional `@karasu-tools/core` peer dependency.
